response: #67 (OMN-1478) adds a new intelligence protocol domain with ProtocolIntentClassifier for classifying user intents from text content across 9 categories, along with a ProtocolIntentGraph protocol for intent persistence operations, 23 protocol-compliance tests, and a bump of the omnibase-core dependency to >=0.9.3. This enables the ONEX platform to support intent-based routing and analysis.
